audit_envelope_findings.root_cause: The manifest generator lower-cased the full Git helper output instead of normalizing only the comparison token, thereby mutating path strings on a case-preserving filesystem.
audit_envelope_findings.impact: The manifest remains content-unambiguous because commits, trees, hashes and casefold populations match, but it fails the declared exact changed-path and cross-platform audit-envelope contract.
audit_envelope_findings.required_fix: Preserve v1.0 and create a non-overwriting case-correct successor manifest from exact Git path bytes; freeze a mixed-case path regression.

probe.mutation: increment actual ASP failed_complete_binding_count from zero to one and recompute the private self digest
probe.observed: public projection accepted the mutated private result and emitted a public digest
probe.expected: typed fail-closed rejection before all private semantic surfaces are discarded

R12_material_findings.root_cause: The projector recomputes binding population, accepted/failed totals, binding digest and basic list counts, but merely type-checks failed-complete, governing-head diagnostics, clause-decision maps and complete-coverage. Full-corpus clause maps are calculated before non-target packages are filtered, so the saved maps are not reconstructible from the persisted package subset.
R12_material_findings.stored_data_reconciliation: All 1601 binding and role-mapping IDs/digests, 1262 referenced compiled objects, source links and actual counts independently reconcile; the finding is a general trust-boundary failure, not evidence that the immutable R12 stored numbers are wrong.
R12_material_findings.impact: A self-consistent re-signed private artifact can alter material semantic summaries and still obtain an accepted public projection, so R12 cannot serve as a fail-closed evidence-admission boundary.
R12_material_findings.required_fix: Build one authoritative persisted reconciliation surface and derive every material summary from it at compile and projection time. Remove, rename or persist sufficient rows for any full-corpus diagnostic that cannot otherwise be recomputed. Add independent mutation tests for every summary field and exact whole-summary equality.

R12_material_findings.reproduction: Dell quoted support for USD 150 and repaired PowerEdge XE9680 hardware for USD 15.
R12_material_findings.root_cause: The unknown right-clause barrier requires at least an owner token plus an unknown head before the material surface. An ownerless one-token unseen head therefore returns no barrier and falls to no_split/non_clause_continuation; the left quote predicate and actor can then union with the right hardware/price group.
R12_material_findings.impact: A separate coordinated event can manufacture a plausible false complete Dell ASP package even when the right event is not a quotation or sale.
R12_material_findings.required_fix: Detect ownerless coordinated finite-head/event surfaces independently of a closed predicate list, split event roles even when the grammatical subject is shared, and fail closed whenever a material right event cannot prove predicate continuity. Freeze one-word, inflection, case and positive shared-event controls.

R12_material_findings.reproduction: Dell quoted a maintenance service covering PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
R12_material_findings.root_cause: The higher nominal-head detector recognizes only for/of/on complement links. Participial or relative complement edges can leave the service head invisible, after which the nearest hardware-at-price path becomes affirmative.
R12_material_findings.impact: A service, bundle or other governing charge can be misreported as Dell hardware ASP.
R12_material_findings.required_fix: Represent complement edges structurally across prepositional, participial and relative forms; require a unique hardware/product governing price head, use taxonomy only for explanation, and freeze nonce-head plus direct-price positive mutations.

known_boundary: Immutable R12 remains valid evidence of one exact zero-new-call execution and independently reconciled current stored counts, route identity and privacy. One P1 trust-boundary failure, two P2 semantic generalization failures and a separate P2 audit-envelope failure prevent 03B qualification. The only legal next stage is a non-overwriting same-stage R13 repair, corrected manifest and new fresh audit; no external or downstream authority exists.
